Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association closure days for 2026 (Reiwa 8):

Starting April 12 (Sunday), the association will be closed every Sunday. If Sunday falls on a national holiday, the closure will shift to the following Monday.

There are also other temporary closures, so please check ahead if you plan to visit.

【Facility Maintenance Closures】
June 6 (Saturday), September 5 (Saturday), December 5 (Saturday), March 20, 2027 (Saturday)

【Hanno Summer Festival Closures】
July 18 (Saturday), July 19 (Sunday)

【Hanno Festival Closures】
November 7 (Saturday), November 8 (Sunday)

【Year-End and New Year Closures】
December 28 (Monday) – January 4, 2027 (Monday) — 8 days total

We apologize for any inconvenience. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

A printable operating calendar for 2026 is available at the link above (April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December).
